headline: Turkey’s Defense Industry Exports Exceed $10 Billion
summary: Turkish Vice President Cevdet Yılmaz announced that Turkey's defense industry exports surpassed $10 billion, reflecting capacity growth achieved over the past 24 years.
why: Turkey's defense manufacturing sector is an expanding component of its industrial export economy and manufacturing output.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Milestone defense export figures boost manufacturing revenues and trade balances.
